name: grocery-planner-sidecar
description: Playwright sidecar that reads live Instacart availability/price data from a logged-in session, for the grocery-planner web app.

scripts.login: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/index.js login
scripts.once: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/index.js once
scripts.loop: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/index.js loop
